fusions.name: Tugging Barb
fusions.desc: Snags the target with a barbed lash that deals 8 damage, up to 1.5 times that at its full 5 tiles, and slows it by 25% for 3 seconds. Each use costs 4% of your maximum health.

fusions.name: Barbed Rip
fusions.desc: Sets a barbed spur in the target and rips it out with a blow that deals 30 damage, ignores its armour and leaves it 15% easier to wound for 8 seconds.

fusions.name: Reel Them In
fusions.desc: Drags up to 6 enemies within 8 tiles onto you and holds their attention for 6 seconds.

fusions.name: Burr Coat
fusions.desc: Each blow that hurts you returns 15% of its damage to whoever dealt it.
